afterImage.name: EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure
afterImage.description: EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure is a U.S. developer, owner and operator of high-density, single-tenant hyperscale data centers serving large cloud, internet, technology and AI customers under long-term contracts. Headquartered in Denver, the platform operates and develops campuses across Virginia, Arizona, Nevada and California and reported more than 1.8 GW delivered or under development, approximately 7 million square feet and more than US$5.9 billion of committed equity and debt by January 2026. Partners Group acquired control through EdgeCore Holdings, L.P. in November 2022 and remained the majority manager after a 2024 client syndication. GIC, OPTrust and Mount Elbert were the founding investors. Campuses, facilities, land entities and financing SPVs are not separate PortCos. No signed sale or later ownership transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
